description: Kernel-mystery probe (part b): does Excel compute NORM.S.DIST(x,TRUE) through its own ERFC/ERF kernels? Column A is x (every x of the norm-s-dist fit sweeps), B = -x*sqrt(0.5), C = -x/sqrt(2), D = x*sqrt(0.5) as doubles; E = NORM.S.DIST(x), F = ERFC.PRECISE(B)/2, G = ERFC.PRECISE(C)/2, H = ERFC(B)/2, I = (1+ERF.PRECISE(D))/2, J = GAUSS(x), K = ERF.PRECISE(D). Halving is exact.
